Booth Tarkington, The Turmoil.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/booth-tarkington/the-turmoil

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Booth Tarkington, the author, the dedicatee, died 1946 (Wikidata Q893138, P570 = 1946-05-19).

First publication of the text used: 1915 (SE colophon: 'The Turmoil was published in 1915 by Booth Tarkington.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1915, before 1931. A work first published in the United States before 1931 is in the United States public domain (rights statement below).
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published there in 1915 (Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Turmoil_(novel), country: United States). The United States rule settles its origin, whatever the death year of any person named above.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
